recommendations.title: Repeated membership test on list `seen`
recommendations.current: `x in seen` scans the whole list on every iteration
recommendations.suggested: Build a set once: `seen_set = set(seen)` and test against it
recommendations.explanation: List membership is linear; set membership is O(1) on average. Elements must be hashable, and the set does not keep order or duplicates (only matters if you iterate it).
